summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a $125,000 extension payment deposited into its trust account to extend the deadline to consummate a business combination from June 15, 2026 to July 15, 2026. Additionally, Nasdaq notified the company it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(f) following payment of past-due fees. The filing is a routine compliance update and trust extension, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premium, or recommendation. Watch for subsequent announcements on a potential business combination.
